subject: Proposed POC roadmap & stakeholder runlist — Acceleron Systems
body:
-----Original Message-----
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acceleron.com>, Priya Raman <priya.r@acceleron.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed POC roadmap & stakeholder runlist — Acceleron Systems

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our demo + a proposed, pragmatic POC roadmap so we can get to a decision fast. I attached a one-page POC charter and a copy with a few Acceleron-specific notes.

High-level objective
- Validate Redwood inference for Acceleron’s "support-ticket summarization + priority scoring" pipeline at production latency and cost targets.

Proposed success criteria (ask: please confirm these or share top-3 alternatives)
1) Latency: 95th percentile response < 350ms for 256-token batches on our staging load (target for hosted mode).
2) Precision: Priority classification F1 >= 0.88 on your holdout dataset (we’ll run 1k eval messages).
3) Economics: token cost per 1k messages within the target budget you shared (approx $0.60 per 1k inference tokens after caching).

POC phases & timeline (recommended)
- Week 0 (setup, 3 business days): contract/PO, staging S3 access, minimal config + sample traffic replay. Owner: Acceleron (Liam, Eng).
- Week 1 (integration, 5 business days): model selection + quick integration, run 1k eval, initial latency profiling. Owner: Redwood SE (me) + Ben Carter (CS).
- Week 2 (tuning & validation, 5 business days): batching/caching config, run full evaluation, compare metrics to success criteria. Owner: Redwood Eng + Acceleron Eng.
- Week 3 (wrap & recommend): handoff checklist, production readiness notes, next-step proposal (dedicated vs hosted). Owner: Laura Bennett (AM) + Acceleron PM.

Stakeholder runlist (please confirm attendees for the kickoff)
- Acceleron: Liam O'Connor (Eng lead), Priya Raman (Product), Procurement contact
- Redwood: Priyom Das (SE, POC lead), Ben Carter (Customer Success), Karthik Iyer (Security lead), Laura Bennett (Account Manager)

Immediate asks / next steps
- Can Acceleron confirm the target success criteria above or propose edits? (reply inline)
- Provide staging S3 credentials (or a short-lived signed URL) for a 10k message sample set — ideally by EOD Monday so we can kick on Wednesday.
- Procurement: if Acceleron can return the PO or signed SOW this week, we’ll reserve the dedicated trial window June 8–15.

Security & compliance
- We’ll share SOC 2 and our VPC/on-prem checklist. Karthik (cc'd) will supply the short evidence pack if you need specifics for procurement.

Attachments: Redwood_POC_Charter_v1.pdf (POC goals, metric definitions, sample run commands)

If this plan looks good I’ll schedule a 30-minute kickoff for next Wednesday and draft an acceptance email for procurement.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124


On Sat, 2 Jun 2028 09:07:00 -0400, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acceleron.com> wrote:
> Priyom —
>
> Really helpful summary, thanks. A couple quick clarifications before we confirm: 
>
> 1) Data retention: for the trial we need confirmation of retention window and deletion process for the sample data — are you able to store the 10k sample for debugging for 7 days and then purge?
> 2) Deployment mode: we are evaluating both hosted Redwood and a private VPC test. Is the POC plan identical for hosted vs private, or will the latency targets differ?
>
> We can provide the sample dataset and staging S3 link (security will give us a signed URL). Procurement is looped and asked for the PO template; I copied them.
>
> If the retention is seven days and you can confirm the security contacts, we should be able to sign and start the week of June 8. I’ll aim to get the staging link to you by Monday.
>
> —Liam
> Liam O'Connor
> Director of Engineering | Acceleron Systems
> liam.oconnor@acceleron.com | +1 (617) 555-0999


On Sat, 2 Jun 2028 11:42:00 -0700, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Liam —
>
> Great questions — answers inline and a small update in the charter attached.
>
> 1) Retention: yes — for POC samples we retain uploaded sample data for 7 days by default and then purge. We can shorten that to 48 hours if you prefer; we’ll provide a signed deletion confirmation when the dataset is removed. Karthik (cc) will share the official deletion process and certificate.
>
> 2) Deployment modes: the POC test plan is the same functional flow, but expected latency baselines differ: hosted trials typically show lower setup friction and predictable latency on our verified instances; private VPC can add network tail latency depending on your location — we’ve included a separate quick checklist in the charter for private deployments. If you're undecided, Ben can run a short call to map cost/latency tradeoffs and recommend quantization/batching setups.
>
> I attached an updated charter (AcceleronNotes) that adds the 7-day retention statement and a private deployment checklist. I also linked the HubSpot deal and a DocuSign SOW draft in case procurement prefers that route.
>
> Proposed kickoff: Wednesday, June 8, 10:00am PT — please confirm attendees and I’ll send an invite.
>
> CC: Karthik Iyer (security) — can you drop the SOC 2 evidence pack to accelerate procurement?
>
> Thanks — Priyom
>
> Attachment: Redwood_POC_Charter_v1_AcceleronNotes.pdf
>
> Priyom Das
> Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
